description: Quotes for changes; binding coverage for purchases and closings; endorsements; certificates of insurance; auto ID cards; answering coverage questions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients cannot close on a home or start a job without proof of coverage; a lapse in coverage can leave a client uninsured; about $720 commission per business day; RPO set by the AMS vendor's backups and same-day notes
manual_workaround: Insurer portals reached directly from the phone for ID cards and binders; insurer service centers handle simple changes for clients; notes kept on paper and entered in the AMS after recovery
dependent_third_parties: AMS vendor; insurers; email provider; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-agent (single point of failure; only licensed person); home office

description: Helping clients report claims to the insurer, tracking claims, and advocating with adjusters; surges after hurricanes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: After a storm clients need to report losses within days; the insurer pays claims, so a delay at the agency slows help but does not stop coverage; claim notes can be rebuilt from insurer portals
manual_workaround: Client contact sheet gives each insurer's 24-hour claims line; owner reports claims through insurer portals from the phone

description: Invoices for about 60 agency-billed commercial policies; deposits to the premium trust account; remittance of net premium to insurers; bank draft forms for direct-billed policies
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Premiums are trust funds (Fla. Stat. 626.561(1)); a payment sent to a fake account can leave a client uninsured and the agency liable; insurers set remittance dates measured in days, not hours
manual_workaround: Hold invoices; phone clients at known numbers before any payment; deposit checks at the branch; remit from the branch if online banking is down

description: Prospect quotes through the comparative rater and insurer portals; renewal reviews and remarketing; applications signed by e-signature
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Renewals are worked 30 to 60 days ahead, so a few days of delay is absorbed; lost prospects cost commission
manual_workaround: Quote directly in insurer portals; paper applications signed in person
dependent_third_parties: Comparative rater vendor; e-signature vendor; wholesale broker

description: Licensing and continuing education; insurer appointments; commission statements; bookkeeping; policy records kept 5 years after expiration (Fla. Stat. 626.748)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Administrative deadlines are measured in weeks; records must stay readily accessible for the Department of Financial Services, but no export of the AMS exists today, so the 24-hour RPO holds only while the AMS vendor holds the data
manual_workaround: Use insurer portals for policy copies; paper files in the garage for pre-2022 business
dependent_third_parties: AMS vendor; accounting SaaS vendor; bookkeeper
